title: Amsterdam · Veluwe Forest and IJssel River
slogan: A 215 km loop out of Naarden fortress
story: Forest lanes and river dikes without city clutter. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 86 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Naarden fortress, Veluwe forest roads, IJssel dike roads, while the fuel checkpoint and Deventer river stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

sections.advice: Amsterdam start → Naarden fortress (22 km) is the reward section in Amsterdam. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
